exposure: health rights of patients with cancer
health rights of patients with senility
health rights of patients with special needs
outcome: Knowledge of medical students regarding health rights in Saudi Arabia
cohort: 267 medical students at King Abdulaziz University (KAU)
finding: The study found a concerning lack of knowledge among KAU medical students regarding health rights of certain patient populations, highlighting the importance of health rights education in medical school.
mod_finding: The study found that only a portion of medical students surveyed (39.7%) were aware that female patients in Saudi Arabia could provide consent for a cesarean section.
